key: < Calcenon City
en: < Calcenon City
ja: < カルセノンシティ

key: Hooo boy!
en: Hooo boy!
ja: はぁ～、参ったね!

key: I came up here to train...
en: I came up here to train...
ja: 鍛錬のためにここまで登ってきたんだ……

key: Body, mind, and soul on the peaks of the mountains!
en: Body, mind, and soul on the peaks of the mountains!
ja: 山の頂上で、体と心と魂を鍛えるためにな!

key: But now that I'm here...
en: But now that I'm here...
ja: でも、実際に来てみたら……

key: Among nature's splendor...
en: Among nature's splendor...
ja: 自然の壮麗さの中で……

key: Among the mountain crags...
en: Among the mountain crags...
ja: 山の岩肌の中で……

key: ...And this awful cold...
en: ...And this awful cold...
ja: ……そして、このひどい寒さの中で……

key: I've realized something.
en: I've realized something.
ja: あることに気づいたんだ。

key: Training is stupid!
en: Training is stupid!
ja: 鍛錬なんて馬鹿げてる!

key: All training is stupid!
en: All training is stupid!
ja: あらゆる鍛錬が馬鹿げてる!

key: Everything from endurance to EV Training-- forget it all!
en: Everything from endurance to EV Training-- forget it all!
ja: 耐久力から努力値トレーニングまで――全部やめだ!

key: I never wanna gain another EV again!
en: I never wanna gain another EV again!
ja: 二度と努力値なんて稼ぎたくない!

key: Next time someone asks me for a password, I'm gonna tell them "stopgains"!
en: Next time someone asks me for a password, I'm gonna tell them "stopgains"!
ja: 今度誰かに合言葉を聞かれたら、「stopgains」って答えてやる!

key: That'll make it so I don't gain a single EV!
en: That'll make it so I don't gain a single EV!
ja: そうすりゃ、努力値なんて一つも稼がずに済むはずだ!

key: Hah! Total freedom will be at hand!
en: Hah! Total freedom will be at hand!
ja: はっ! 完全な自由が手に入るってわけさ!

key: That'll stick it to the world!
en: That'll stick it to the world!
ja: 世界に一泡吹かせてやる!

key: Take that, mountain peaks!
en: Take that, mountain peaks!
ja: 食らえ、山の頂よ!

key: ABSOL: Awwoooo!
en: ABSOL: Awwoooo!
ja: アブソル: アオオオン!

key: ABSOL: Sol...
en: ABSOL: Sol...
ja: アブソル: アブ……

key: Haah! I climbed up all this way from the Circus and I'm pumped!
en: Haah! I climbed up all this way from the Circus and I'm pumped!
ja: はぁ! サーカスからここまで登ってきて、気合十分だぜ!

key: ...Deflated.
en: ...Deflated.
ja: オーディン: ……しぼんだ。

key: Ugh... Maybe I'll climb down now.
en: Ugh... Maybe I'll climb down now.
ja: うう……もう降りようかな。

key: This is but a small section of Route 4. The real challenge is over that cliff. For now, a different challenge!
en: This is but a small section of Route 4. The real challenge is over that cliff. For now, a different challenge!
ja: ここは4番道路のほんの一部にすぎない。本当の試練はあの崖の向こうだ。とりあえず、今は別の挑戦といこう!

key: Hm! A challenge indeed!
en: Hm! A challenge indeed!
ja: ゴロー: ふむ! まさに挑戦だな!

key: I'll need to work on my battling skills as much as I do my Rock Climbing skills!
en: I'll need to work on my battling skills as much as I do my Rock Climbing skills!
ja: 岩登りの腕前と同じくらい、バトルの腕も磨かないとな!

key: Isn't this place beautiful? If a bit chilly... But I know what'll warm me up!
en: Isn't this place beautiful? If a bit chilly... But I know what'll warm me up!
ja: ここ、きれいな場所だと思わない? ちょっと寒いけど……でも、あったまる方法なら知ってるんだ!

key: That's much better!
en: That's much better!
ja: エレン: ずっとマシになったわ!

key: But really... brrrrr.
en: But really... brrrrr.
ja: でも、本当に……ぶるぶる。

key: Hey! If you're not up to this cold, you should just go back to Calcenon!
en: Hey! If you're not up to this cold, you should just go back to Calcenon!
ja: おい! この寒さについていけないなら、カルセノンに戻ったほうがいいぞ!

key: I was outdone. That's new.
en: I was outdone. That's new.
ja: ラッシー: 負けちゃった。初めてかも。

key: Hey, maybe I should be the one going back to the city.
en: Hey, maybe I should be the one going back to the city.
ja: ねえ、街に戻るのはあたしのほうかもね。

key: I'll show you why I'm on top!
en: I'll show you why I'm on top!
ja: 俺がなぜトップなのか、見せてやるよ!

key: GG.
en: GG.
ja: ジョージ: GG。

key: Defeat.
en: Defeat.
ja: 敗北。

key: HARDY: Noel! You out here!?
en: HARDY: Noel! You out here!?
ja: ハーディ: ノエル! こんなとこにいるのか!?

key: Oh, \PN. Yo!
en: Oh, \PN. Yo!
ja: おっ、\PN。よう!

key: You haven't seen Anna or Noel, have ya?
en: You haven't seen Anna or Noel, have ya?
ja: アンナかノエル、見なかったか?

key: Tough...
en: Tough...
ja: きついな……

key: Both of 'em are totally on the MIA.
en: Both of 'em are totally on the MIA.
ja: 二人とも完全に行方不明なんだ。

key: Someone saw 'em roll outta the east exit from Calcenon, but then there isn't so much of a trace.
en: Someone saw 'em roll outta the east exit from Calcenon, but then there isn't so much of a trace.
ja: カルセノンの東口から出てくのを見た奴はいたんだけど、そっからほとんど手がかりがなくてな。

key: If Team Meteor got them...
en: If Team Meteor got them...
ja: もしチームメテオに捕まってたら……

key: Aya too...
en: Aya too...
ja: アヤのことも……

key: Ain't no way in hell I'm gonna let them get away with all this!
en: Ain't no way in hell I'm gonna let them get away with all this!
ja: こんなこと、絶対に許すわけにはいかねえ!

key: HARDY: Yo, \PN!
en: HARDY: Yo, \PN!
ja: ハーディ: よう、\PN!

key: Huh, you ran into Charlotte and Saphira on the way here?
en: Huh, you ran into Charlotte and Saphira on the way here?
ja: え、ここに来る途中でシャルロットとサファイラに会ったのか?

key: I didn't see 'em at all... Maybe we just missed each other.
en: I didn't see 'em at all... Maybe we just missed each other.
ja: 俺は全然見かけなかったな……すれ違っちまったのかもな。

key: So they were all right after all. Sweet.
en: So they were all right after all. Sweet.
ja: じゃあ、二人とも無事だったってわけか。よかったな。

key: Good to know that's two less we gotta worry about!
en: Good to know that's two less we gotta worry about!
ja: 心配する相手が二人減ったってのはありがたいぜ!

key: So, according to Rini, the source of the sleeping effect should be somewhere east of here.
en: So, according to Rini, the source of the sleeping effect should be somewhere east of here.
ja: で、リニによると、眠りの効果の発信源はここより東のどこかにあるはずなんだ。

key: You beat Amy, right, mate?
en: You beat Amy, right, mate?
ja: エイミーは倒したんだよな、相棒?

key: Then take this!
en: Then take this!
ja: なら、これを受け取ってくれ!

key: HARDY: I've been hangin' onto that for you for a while.
en: HARDY: I've been hangin' onto that for you for a while.
ja: ハーディ: しばらく預かってたんだ。

key: Wouldn't have done much good before, but now you can use that to scale steep walls like these!
en: Wouldn't have done much good before, but now you can use that to scale steep walls like these!
ja: 前までは大して役に立たなかっただろうけど、今ならこういう急な壁も登れるようになるぜ!

key: Well, you probably already knew that.
en: Well, you probably already knew that.
ja: まあ、もう分かってたと思うけどな。

key: No time to waste, then!
en: No time to waste, then!
ja: なら、無駄にしてる時間はねえな!

key: I'll go on ahead.
en: I'll go on ahead.
ja: 俺は先に行くぜ。

key: Let's take back Agate City!
en: Let's take back Agate City!
ja: アゲートシティを取り戻そうぜ!

key: And eventually... Aya too.
en: And eventually... Aya too.
ja: それに、いずれは……アヤのことも。

key: Oof, were you hoping to come through here?
en: Oof, were you hoping to come through here?
ja: おっと、ここを通りたかったのか?

key: Sorry about that!
en: Sorry about that!
ja: 悪いな!

key: A bunch of rocks slid down from the upper part of the route just then, but don't you fret!
en: A bunch of rocks slid down from the upper part of the route just then, but don't you fret!
ja: さっき道の上のほうから岩がどっと落ちてきちまってな、でも心配すんな!

key: I'll get 'em cleaned up in a jiffy, so just hang tight for a bit.
en: I'll get 'em cleaned up in a jiffy, so just hang tight for a bit.
ja: すぐに片付けるから、ちょっとだけ待っててくれ。

key: Did you think you could just sneak up here without a fight?
en: Did you think you could just sneak up here without a fight?
ja: 戦わずにここまで来られるとでも思ったのか?

key: Wait- you weren't-
en: Wait- you weren't-
ja: エディ: 待て――お前は――

key: I can't believe you beat my 1337 H4X0RS...
en: I can't believe you beat my 1337 H4X0RS...
ja: 俺のエリートハッカー軍団を倒すなんて信じらんねえ……

key: Something glimmers in the cinders of the campfire, but it's impossible to pull out.
en: Something glimmers in the cinders of the campfire, but it's impossible to pull out.
ja: キャンプファイヤーの燃えかすの中で何かが光っているが、取り出すことはできそうにない。

key: Perhaps a spark would draw it out?
en: Perhaps a spark would draw it out?
ja: 火花を起こせば、引き出せるかもしれない。
